name: Expert_ABH_BH_RSI
summary: This EA uses the CBH_BH_RSI signal filter, which combines an RSI indicator with a moving average to identify overbought/oversold conditions and generate trade signals. It operates within MetaQuotes' standard Expert Advisor framework with fixed lot money management and no trailing stop. Entry and exit are controlled by configurable threshold values applied to the signal strength.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CBH_BH_RSI信号过滤器，结合RSI指标和移动平均线来识别超买/超卖条件并生成交易信号。它在MetaQuotes标准EA框架内运行，采用固定手数资金管理且无追踪止损。入场和出场由可配置的信号强度阈值控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于RSI指标的均值回归方法，通过RSI(37)判断市场的超买超卖状态，再用MA(7)对RSI值进行平滑处理以减少假信号。入场条件依赖信号阈值机制：当综合信号强度超过开仓阈值(40)时开仓，低于平仓阈值(20)时平仓，这是一种基于信号强度的多空判断逻辑。出场条件主要通过信号反转触发平仓，同时支持止损和止盈设置但默认值均为0即未启用。仓位管理采用固定手数模式(CMoneyFixedLot)，默认0.1手，不根据账户权益动态调整。资金管理方面使用10%的百分比参数和固定手数组合，缺少动态仓位缩放和风险控制机制。整体策略缺乏止损保护，没有追踪止损，在趋势行情中可能面临较大回撤风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a mean reversion approach based on the RSI indicator, using RSI(37) to identify overbought and oversold market conditions, then applying MA(7) smoothing to the RSI value to reduce false signals. Entry conditions rely on a signal threshold mechanism: positions are opened when the composite signal strength exceeds the open threshold (40) and closed when it falls below the close threshold (20), which is a signal-strength-based long/short decision logic. Exit conditions are primarily triggered by signal reversal for closing positions, with stop loss and take profit settings supported but both defaulted to 0 meaning they are effectively disabled. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default of 0.1 lots, without dynamic adjustment based on account equity. Money management combines a 10% percentage parameter with fixed lots, lacking dynamic position scaling and comprehensive risk control mechanisms. The overall strategy lacks stop loss protection and trailing stops, which may lead to significant drawdowns during trending market conditions.

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdOpen
parameters.description: 开仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度超过此值时开仓
parameters.description_en: Open signal threshold [0...100], open when signal exceeds

parameters.name: Signal_ThresholdClose
parameters.description: 平仓信号阈值[0...100]，信号强度低于此值时平仓
parameters.description_en: Close signal threshold [0...100], close when signal falls below

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description: 执行交易的价位水平，0为市价执行
parameters.description_en: Trade execution price level, 0 for market execution

parameters.name: Signal_StopLevel
parameters.description: 止损水平（点数），0表示未设置止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss level (points), 0 means no SL set

parameters.name: Signal_TakeLevel
parameters.description: 止盈水平（点数），0表示未设置止盈

parameters.name: Signal__PeriodRSI
parameters.description: RSI指标周期，用于判断超买超卖

pros: 基于RSI的均值回归策略逻辑清晰，RSI周期37较长可减少噪音
使用MA对RSI平滑处理，有效过滤短期波动产生的假信号
采用MetaQuotes标准EA框架，代码结构规范、模块化程度高
信号阈值机制灵活，可同时控制开仓和平仓条件
固定手数资金管理简单直观，适合初学者理解和调试
pros_en: Clear mean reversion strategy logic based on RSI; the longer 37-period RSI reduces market noise
MA smoothing on RSI effectively filters out false signals from short-term fluctuations
Uses MetaQuotes standard EA framework with well-structured, modular code architecture
Flexible signal threshold mechanism allows simultaneous control of both entry and exit conditions
Fixed lot money management is simple and intuitive, suitable for beginners to understand and debug
cons: 止损和止盈默认值均为0，交易没有硬性风险保护，可能导致巨额亏损
没有追踪止损机制，在有利行情中无法锁定利润
固定手数不根据账户规模和波动性动态调整，风险管理不够精细
仅依赖单一RSI信号过滤器，缺乏多维度信号确认，容易产生虚假入场
没有点差过滤和滑点保护，在恶劣市场条件下可能造成不必要的损失
cons_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, providing no hard risk protection which may lead to catastrophic losses
No trailing stop mechanism means profits cannot be locked in during favorable market moves
Fixed lot sizing does not dynamically adjust based on account size or volatility, resulting in coarse risk management
Relies on a single RSI signal filter without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to false entries
No spread filter or slippage protection, which may cause unnecessary losses under adverse market conditions
improvements: 设置合理的默认止损和止盈值，确保每笔交易都有硬性风险保护
增加追踪止损模块替代当前的TrailingNone，实现利润保护和动态出场
引入多时间框架确认或额外的信号过滤器（如MACD、布林带），提高信号可靠性
加入点差过滤和交易时段控制，避免在高成本和低流动性时段交易
improvements_en: Set reasonable default stop loss and take profit values to ensure every trade has hard risk protection
Replace TrailingNone with an actual trailing stop module to enable profit protection and dynamic exits
Introduce multi-timeframe confirmation or additional signal filters (e.g., MACD, Bollinger Bands) to improve signal reliability
Add spread filtering and trading session controls to avoid trading during high-cost and low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 止损和止盈均默认为0，交易完全没有硬性止损保护
没有新K线检查机制(Expert_EveryTick=false部分缓解)，可能在同一K线重复开仓
固定手数不随账户波动调整，在连续亏损时无法降低风险敞口
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit both default to 0, trades have absolutely no hard stop protection
No new bar check mechanism (Expert_EveryTick=false partially mitigates), may open repeated positions on the same bar
Fixed lots do not adjust with account fluctuations, unable to reduce risk exposure during consecutive losses
